_doc: How Jira 'model' issues map to work-history. Change the customfield ids to match your Jira (Jira settings → Issues → Custom fields, or GET /rest/api/3/field).
jql: project = MDL AND issuetype = Model ORDER BY created DESC

users._doc: Jira Cloud may hide emailAddress. Map accountId → username here (username = local part of the e-mail used by the hooks).
